response.justification: This candidate is a full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general programming and craftsmanship skills, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or deep-learning workload optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. The resume shows no hardware-software co-design or chip architecture background at all, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite meeting general seniority/experience thresholds.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers at Sociomantic)
Strong track record of technical leadership, teaching, and open-source contribution
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU/accelerator experience
No background in SIMD/MIMD or chip design/performance-power trade-off work

key_factors.factor: No deep-learning or GPU workload optimization experience
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
